bio: Port Moresby wildlife park with tree kangaroos, cassowaries, birds of paradise and a walk-through WWII aviary.
Waigani museum of over 30,000 objects, from traditional boats to Sepik art, with WWII planes and tanks outside.
Commonwealth war cemetery 19 km north-east of Port Moresby, with 3,824 graves, many from the Kokoda campaign.
Waigani's Parliament House, styled on a Maprik haus tambaran spirit house, with group tours on weekdays.
Gordon's largest produce market in Port Moresby, selling vegetables from other provinces; go with a known driver.
Private resort island in Bootless Bay with snorkelling and diving; day visits by ferry from Tahira, booked ahead.
PNG's highest mountain at 4,509 m, climbed with a local guide from Keglsugl, with a night on the mountain.
Extinct volcano in the Southern Highlands, second-highest in PNG, climbed with a guide in about a day.

reroute: Only fact found is that it is the highest point in Eastern Highlands (about 3,615 m) in remote Lufa District; no visitor source, access or activities. Send to review or drop.

bio: Ramsar-listed upland lake south-west of Mendi, home to ten fish found nowhere else, with villages reached by canoe.
Gold-mining island group off New Ireland, reached by daily flight from Port Moresby, with Kunaye Beach Resort.
Largest of the Admiralty Islands, with Lorengau on Seeadler Harbor, WWII relics and reefs for diving; reached by air.
Island where flights arrive for Bougainville, with Buka Passage boat trips and a road circling the island.
Island 10 minutes by boat from Buka Market, with a mona canoe, an ANZAC memorial and views across the passage.
Active volcano and Bougainville's highest peak at 2,715 m, climbed over three days from Wakunai with a local guide.
Crescent island around a turquoise lagoon, with WWII airstrip relics; a four-hour boat ride from Buka.
Former colonial port island at the entrance to Milne Bay, 20 minutes to walk round, reached by boat from Alotau.
Rainforest headland with a fringing reef and dive resort, reached by sea, with over 60 dive sites within an hour.
Mountainous D'Entrecasteaux island of rainforest trails and birdwatching, reached by boat from Alotau.
Largest of the D'Entrecasteaux Islands, a geothermal rainforest island with birdwatching, reached only by boat.
Raised coral atolls with white beaches and preserved traditional dancing, reached by twice-weekly flight.
About 100 islands ringed by coral reefs, known for diving and visited mainly by yacht; ask before fishing.
Most accessible Louisiade island, with quiet beaches and a gold mine closed in 2004; reached by air from Alotau.
Volcanic D'Entrecasteaux island rising to Mount Vineuo, with rainforest and birdwatching; reached from Alotau.
